nota.miscelanea.capsula.0: “If you find this, hello from the past! I hope creepers still don't understand doors.”
nota.miscelanea.capsula.1: “I planted an oak today. If it's still standing, look after it for me.”
nota.miscelanea.capsula.2: “Note: never dig straight down. I learned the hard way.”
nota.miscelanea.capsula.3: “This cookie was for you. Well, the other one. I ate this one.”
nota.miscelanea.capsula.4: “In 100 years, will phantoms still not let anyone sleep?”
nota.miscelanea.capsula.5: “Snake high score: 340. Beat it if you can.”
nota.miscelanea.capsula.6: “Dear future me: return the books to the village library.”
nota.miscelanea.capsula.7: “I hid my most valuable things here. Yes, mostly cookies.”
nota.miscelanea.capsula.8: “I saw a blue morpho butterfly. Nobody believes me. It was real.”
nota.miscelanea.capsula.9: “If it's raining while you read this, play the Song of Clear Skies.”
